text:
Ashley: quick sync — attaching weekly zonal rollup. need callouts for AP-S, EU-W and spot runway 
Kumar: thanks — skimming now. can you paste the key numbers? 
Ashley: projected GPU hours this week: NA: 28k, EU: 18.5k, AP-S: 9.2k. committed reserved covers NA+EU but AP-S is ~40% spot. 
Ben: AP-S spike last night pushed preemptions up 3x, saw queue time ~350ms on small-batch workloads. 
Sylvia: noisy-neighbor on cluster ap-s-gamma — one tenant was running sustained long-seq decoding, hogging memory. we throttled but it impacted KV cache hit rates. 
Ashley: noted. impact on throughput was ~6% for serving tier — cost delta ~+$2.7k projected if sustained for week. 
Olga: is there headroom to shift canary traffic from ap-s-gamma to ap-s-beta? beta has lower load but is on older drivers. 
Kumar: beta driver mismatch: cuda 12.1 vs 12.2 in gamma. models with trt kernels regress ~4% latency if we move them without rebuild. 
Ben: short term option: scale up ap-s-gamma by +2 GPUs (reserved burst) and schedule the heavy tenant to off-peak windows. longer term: reprovision drivers on beta next maintenance window. 
Ashley: cost for +2 reserved GPUs in AP-S (on-demand reserved pool) ~+$1,600/week. still cheaper than degraded SLAs. 
Sylvia: also saw increased packet drops between ap-s-gamma pods and storage at 03:10 UTC — packetloss ~0.7% for ~12m. root cause: NIC firmware regression on that rack. infra-bot deployed firmware rollback at 03:25 and drops fell back to normal. 
infra-bot: note — rollback completed on rack-ap-s-07 at 03:26 UTC. ticket INF-2119 created. 
Olga: can we schedule a driver/firmware consolidation plan? having mixed images is biting us during failover. 
Kumar: plan proposal: week 1 - snapshot + test images on beta, week 2 - converge drivers across ap-s clusters, week 3 - migrate heavy tenants. need maintenance windows. 
Ben: dependency: spot runway. if we do driver changes, we should avoid high spot eviction windows (Mon 00-08 UTC historically). 
Ashley: solid. action items: 1) Approve +2 reserved GPUs in AP-S for 72h (Ben) 2) Schedule driver convergence plan (Kumar) 3) Notify customers in ap-s about potential canary shift (SRE comms) (Olga) 4) Monitor KV cache hit and queue time dashboards hourly (Sylvia). 
Kumar: I'll open change with proposed windows — prefer Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC. 
Sylvia: putting an automated alert for KV cache hit falling below 82% and queue_time_p95 > 300ms. 
Ben: approved +2 reserved GPUs for 72h, will attach to ap-s-gamma via autoscaler override. :thumbsup: 
Ashley: thanks. one more ask — forecast sensitivity: if AP-S demand grows 20% (customer onboarding), we need additional ~3.8k GPU hours/week which equals ~+8 GPUs sustained. that impacts cost+procurement lead time. 
Olga: flagging procurement — lead time for physical orders ~6-8 weeks, but cloud reserved capacity can be added in 24-48h if budget ok. 
Kumar: I'll model two scenarios and post updated numbers tomorrow: baseline, +20% demand. 
Ashley: cool. if no other blockers, we'll run the short-term reserve and driver plan. 
Ben: FYI — I'll coordinate autoscaler policy to ensure burst scales before queue grows. 
Sylvia: & I'll keep an eye on network telemetry for that rack. 
Olga: I'll draft a short note for customers and internal oncall change window. 
Ashley: end of thread: thanks all, will follow up with the updated forecast doc and the change request links. :raised_hands:
